reproduction_assumptions: This operational exploratory profile is non-formal and does not change the rejected strict P1 evidence.
Alpha, beta, and cross-tier weight are non-formal values from the preserved raw-power P1 report.
Lambda_wire=0.0020119160767721133 is the FFT-local measured matched-R2 candidate from results/parameter_studies/raw_power_strict_20260730/r2_wire/fft/lambda_wire_report.json.
The FFT-local lambda_wire fit was rejected for formal or shared promotion because R^2 was below 0.95, it had one monotonicity violation, and cross-workload transfer was not validated.
This lambda_wire value is used only to test end-to-end optimizer feasibility on one MATMUL point; the result is not paper-equivalent.
McPAT uses direct gem5 O3 counters; its reported dynamic and leakage powers are consumed without post-processing multipliers.
Cache delay, area, and aspect-ratio-preserving geometry come only from the local CACTI run; no published cache table values are used.
The 8.72 effective local stack-resistance factor came from an earlier Table III temperature anchor and should be recalibrated after local-CACTI geometry changes.
CLIP-3D proposals and fixed-bin are both validated with real HotSpot; a guard prevents a proxy-induced thermal-BIPS regression and records any fallback.
Cool3D-standard and SA+lambda details are under-specified; their deterministic reproduction algorithms record all parameters and candidates.
